summary: Comprehensive testing of ExplainaPro with new JWT authentication and FFmpeg video rendering features. Backend APIs 100% successful with all auth and render endpoints working perfectly. Frontend authentication flow fully functional. AI generation and storyboard creation work flawlessly. However, project persistence issue prevents testing full end-to-end render workflow.

integration_issues.issue: Projects don't appear in dashboard despite successful storyboard generation
integration_issues.impact: Users cannot access created projects, blocking full render workflow testing
integration_issues.workaround: Backend render APIs work correctly when called directly

passed_tests: POST /api/auth/register - creates user with JWT token
POST /api/auth/login - authenticates user and returns token
GET /api/auth/me - returns user data with valid token
Invalid login attempts properly rejected with 401
Auth modal opens when clicking Sign In button
User registration flow works in frontend
User login flow works in frontend
Logged in user sees name in navbar
Logout button works correctly
POST /api/render - starts video render job with job ID
GET /api/render/{jobId} - returns render status and progress
Invalid render job IDs rejected with 404
AI script generation creates detailed storyboards
Project creation navigates to /create successfully
Storyboard displays 5 slides with characters and content
All existing APIs continue to work (script, image, video generation)
All mocked APIs work (voice, music, SFX)
Search endpoints work (assets, audio)
Status check APIs work
Dashboard loads when user is authenticated
Frontend UI components render correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: The project persistence issue from iteration_1 still exists - projects are not being saved properly to MongoDB after storyboard generation. While all APIs work and authentication is perfect, users cannot access their created projects. This blocks testing of the full render modal workflow. Fix the MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in project saving to enable complete end-to-end testing.

success_percentage.backend: 100% (21/21 tests passed - including all new auth and render endpoints)
success_percentage.frontend: 90% (Auth fully functional, AI generation works, but project persistence fails)
success_percentage.integration: 85% (All API integrations work, but missing project persistence breaks workflow)
